title: Lane name to item
current: A lane branch or worktree directory is named by the item's public reference, PREFIX-N, in any project. Engine readers turn a lane name back into its item through item_id_for_lane_name: a recorded item_worktrees branch or path wins, then the name resolves as a public reference through its project's prefix and sequence, and a trial/ part is ignored. The number in the name is a project sequence and is never read as items.id; a name that resolves to nothing names no item. The worktree-status commit gate, the SubagentStop safety-net auto-commit, tool-call telemetry attribution, trial-branch cleanup and the expected-worktree path all read lanes this way, so customer prefixes behave like YOK. Telemetry without a control-plane read attributes no item. `item-next-id <project>` prints the next public reference from that project's own prefix and sequence. HC-item-ref-construction flags a literal project prefix followed by -(, -\d or -[0-9], and int(match.group(...)) feeding an item id.
